copy.curiosityHook: Can two reincarnated souls survive an ancient grudge when legendary beasts tear through a contemporary city to find them?
copy.description: Bound to a 16th-century warrior's spirit, Ethan tracks down Sarah, the reincarnated soul of his ancient love, just as monstrous dragons descend upon modern Los Angeles in a fierce hunt for the couple.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful, and action-heavy, blending fantasy spectacle with the relentless energy of a creature invasion.
copy.whyWatch: Director Shim Hyung-rae orchestrates a brisk, 90-minute spectacle fusing ancient Korean legend with high-octane creature-feature destruction in modern urban streets.

allowedMaterial: Ethan carries the spirit of a 16th-century Korean warrior
Ethan finds Sarah, the reincarnated spirit of the warrior's beloved

excludedMaterial: Final fate of Ethan or Sarah
